3090199.findings: Two photos. Photo 1: a cardboard box plus two yellow tins, a blue plastic tub and a clear plastic box holding a very large number of old trade and cigarette cards, mostly in rubber-banded or string-tied bundles with a handwritten paper label on each (looks like one bundle per set), two small dark red and black card boxes, loose cards in sleeves and a large index sheet lying on the tub. Unis and Schools (1929), W62-282A Footballers (1933), W62-233 Past and Present Champions (1903-1910), W62-247 Victoria Cross Heroes (full set of 25), W62-277A Wild Animal Heads (1934); Sniders and Abrahams S88-13.2 Butterflies and Moths, S88-15 Crests of British Warships (complete set of 64); Godfrey Phillips P50.142 Test Cricketers 1932-33, P50.145 Who's Who in Aust.
